{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2019–20 |team=Evansville Purple Aces |image=Evansville Purple Aces wordmark.svg |image_size=200 |conference=Missouri Valley Conference |division= |short_conf=MVC |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=9–23 |conf_record=0–18 |head_coach=[[Walter McCarty]] (placed on admin. leave on Dec. 27, fired on Jan. 21) [[Bennie Seltzer]] (interim, from Dec. 27 to Jan. 21) [[Todd Lickliter]] (starting Jan. 21) |hc_year = |asst_coach1=Bennie Seltzer |asst_coach2=Logan Baumann |asst_coach3=Terrence Commodore |asst_coach4= |stadium=[[Ford Center (Evansville)|Ford Center]] |champion= |bowl = |bowl_result = }} {{2019–20 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2019–20 Evansville Purple Aces men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Evansville]] during the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Purple Aces played their home games at the [[Ford Center (Evansville)|Ford Center]] as members of the [[Missouri Valley Conference]] (MVC). They finished the season 9–23, 0–18 in MVC play to finish in last place. They lost in the first round of the [[2020 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|MVC tournament]] to [[2019–20 Valparaiso Crusaders men's basketball team|Valparaiso]]. They were coached by [[Walter McCarty]] until he was placed on administrative leave on December 27 for alleged [[Title IX]] violations{{Cite web|last=West|first=Jenna|title=Evansville Places Walter McCarty on Leave|url=https://www.si.com/college/2019/12/27/walter-mccarty-on-leave-evansville-title-ix-allegations|access-date=2021-10-06|website=Sports Illustrated|language=en-us}} and ultimately fired on January 21.{{Cite web|last=Lindskog|first=Chad|title=University of Evansville fires Walter McCarty as head men's basketball coach|url=https://www.courierpress.com/story/sports/college/evansville/2020/01/21/walter-mccarty-resigns-evansville-basketball-coach/4483959002/|access-date=2021-10-06|website=Evansville Courier & Press|language=en-US}} Assistant coach [[Bennie Seltzer]] acted as interim coach until [[Todd Lickliter]] was hired as the new head coach.{{Cite web|title=Former Iowa head coach Todd Lickliter hired at Evansville|url=https://247sports.com/college/iowa/Article/Iowa-Hawkeyes-Basketball-Todd-Lickliter-Evansville-Purple-Aces-Big-Ten-Conference-Coaching-Hires-142560141/|access-date=2021-10-06|website=HawkeyeInsider.com|language=en-US}} ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Evansville Purple Aces men's basketball team|Purple Aces]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 11–21, 5–13 in [[2017–18 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball season|MVC play]] to finish in last place. First, second-year head coach Walter McCarty was placed on administrative leave by the school on December 27, 2019, pending a [[Title IX]] investigation against him.{{Cite web|url=https://www.news-leader.com/story/sports/college/msu/2019/12/27/evansville-basketball-walter-mccarty-placed-administrative-leave/2757279001/|title=Evansville coach Walter McCarty placed on web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28378080/evansville-walter-mccarty-administrative-leave-amid-title-ix-probe|title=Evansville's Walter McCarty on administrative leave
